observedFailure.reason: Four asserted source mutations exited 2 for their intended named reason: renaming #__sp_contrast made the authored axe target legs DEAD at 0 -> 0; repairing the injected computed-contrast sample too early produced ratio 18.88 and made its detector leg DEAD; restoring the old whole-shadow regex made the contracted-shadow leg DEAD; bypassing shadow geometry made the same contracted outer/inset leg DEAD with outerVisible=true and insetVisible=true.
observedFailure.restoredPass: After restoring the source, the exact caller passed all 18 authored legs and exited 0; the full sweep repeated the same self-proof before measuring any app surface.
